name: margem-certa-extension
description: Chrome extension that shows the real profit of Mercado Livre and Shopee listings after fees
author: Pablo Tosati

scripts.package: node -e "process.stdout.write(require('./manifest.json').version)" | xargs -I{} sh -c 'rm -f margem-certa-loja-{}.zip && zip -qr margem-certa-loja-{}.zip manifest.json src popup icons && echo margem-certa-loja-{}.zip'
